title: Self-work-package dossiers: BADF's own PRs carry a G07 dossier with digest-bound evidence, validated in the composed world
objective: Close the gap between how BADF governs other projects and itself: `self-dossier <WP>` assembles a G07 dossier from measured evidence (the change diff, repo, the compose transcript, the docs diff), bound so it stays verifiable on the branch, in the composed world and on main after the squash; compose validates it; the single-collaborator approvals gap is a carried condition on a HUMAN_REQUIRED dossier -- recorded, not hidden.
business_value: Every BADF work package so far merged on CI plus traceability without a gate dossier: authority validation and evidence binding were exercised only for foreign work packages.
in_scope: gate: a self-WP source-change diff excludes its own work/<WP>/ and the lockfile, verified against base..HEAD

self-dossier <WP> --composed <transcript> assembler (HUMAN_REQUIRED; carried condition for the missing independent reviewer; documentation NOT_APPLICABLE with declared non-coverage when no docs changed)
compose: validates the candidate WP's G07 dossier in the composed tree (exit 0 or 3 accepted)
this PR carries its own self-dossier
out_of_scope: approving anything: the tool binds evidence, the human merges
acceptance_criteria: self-dossier assembles a G07 dossier that renders HUMAN_REQUIRED (exit 3) with all four evidence records digest-bound
an edit outside work/<WP>/ after assembly invalidates the source-change binding; an edit inside it (re-sign, record) does not
the dossier still validates in the composed world and on the pristine main after squash
compose reports the self-dossier and fails on exit 1/2
this PR's own dossier is validated by CI

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch. Dogfood: work/WP-2026-0033/gate-dossier.G07.json is assembled by the tool this WP ships.
